返回明确是测试数据，不代表工具真的执行。产品状态机、DOM 更新和展开动作仍使用当前正式源码，只替换网络传输。

## _request

| 参数 | 类型 | 默认 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|---|
| address | text | required | 原任务地址 |
| generation | number | required | 浏览器代数 |
| session | text | required | 浏览器任务身份 |

| 返回 | 类型 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| result | any | 官方 fetch_all 的确定性 data 响应 |

Use `address`, `generation` and `session`。开始时运行，拉取时完成；每个请求仍携带原任务身份。卡片由正式组件渲染器生成，用来观察轮询是否破坏展开容器。


The initial card shell is generated by the same component module as production. Its running status is fixture data, not evidence of a real filesystem action. A pull returns the same sequence with a terminal leaf value, forcing the client to exercise its update path. The source decoder and callback remain unchanged, so replacing the full timeline, failing to persist the phase, or ignoring the task identity still causes the test to fail. The data URL retains route information in its fragment even when the bridge reports an error.

We **done = text.contains(text=`address`, sub="/pull?")**.
We **status = "running"**.
1. `done`
  We **status = "succeeded"**.

`card` =

| seq | status | status_text | output | html |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `status` | `status` | "确定性测试观察，非真实工具结果" | "@CARD@" |

We **cards = table.append(list=table.empty_list(), item=`card`)**.

`payload` =

| ok | gen | session | done | status | page_html | trace_cards |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| True | `generation` | `session` | `done` | `status` | "<section id=\"qd-answer-document\">普通 Markdown 测试片段</section>" | `cards` |

We **target = "data:application/json," + net.url_encode(text=json.stringify(value=`payload`)) + "#route=" + `address` + "&qd_session=" + `session` + "&qd_generation=" + str(`generation`)**.

`requests` =

| @ | url | method |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | `target` | GET |

Return *[实际经过官方桥接](browser.fetch_all(requests=`requests`, then="on_response"))*.


## _state_request

| 参数 | 类型 | 默认 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|---|
| session | text | required | 要切换的任务 |
| epoch | number | required | 切换序号 |

| 返回 | 类型 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| result | any | 确定性新任务快照 |

Use `session` and `epoch`。新任务没有旧卡片和问题，代数从零开始。响应仍经过正式 on_state，不能在夹具里替产品补上持久赋值。


The replacement task deliberately starts with no cards and generation zero. If the old task's token or displayed sequence survives the real state callback, the checker refuses to start a new round. The task id and epoch come from the request, not a test assignment to production state. This fixture establishes only deterministic UI behavior; backend session directories are verified by the real capabilities suite.

We **cards = table.empty_list()**.

`payload` =

| ok | gen | session | epoch | done | status | page_html | trace_cards | plugins_html | sessions_html |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| True | 0 | `session` | str(`epoch`) | True | "ready" | "<section id=\"qd-answer-document\">切换任务的测试片段</section>" | `cards` | "" | "" |

We **target = "data:application/json," + net.url_encode(text=json.stringify(value=`payload`)) + "#qd_epoch=" + str(`epoch`)**.

`requests` =

| @ | url | method |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | `target` | GET |

Return *[真实切换回调](browser.fetch_all(requests=`requests`, then="on_state"))*.
